summary: Verified the geo-block wallet fix end-to-end. In real mode, /api/wallet/summary and /api/wallet/spot correctly return wallet_usdt=0.0 with wallet_error/error populated — demo balance ($10,357.63) is NOT leaked, only exposed under demo_wallet_usdt. Frontend /wallet correctly shows 'Real · Not Connected' label, yellow banner with data-testid=wallet-connection-error, Available USDT=0, In Positions=$179.34 (live bots). Demo-mode regression: after flipping admin to demo via DB, the backend returns wallet_usdt=10357.6271, mode=demo, no error; frontend shows 'Total Assets (USDT)' label with no banner and no mode badge. Admin mode restored to 'real' at end of testing.

wallet_summary_real_mode.wallet_error_starts_with: Binance is unreachable from this server region

frontend_wallet_real_mode.wallet-connection-error_text: Cannot Reach Binance — Binance is unreachable from this server region (geo-restriction). Your funds are safe in Binance — we cannot read the balance from here.

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing noise: Binance WebSocket connections return HTTP 451 (region blocked) — floods the console on every page. Not part of this fix, but consider suppressing/rate-limiting the reconnect logic so console isn't flooded.

Wallet.jsx also renders a second 'Live Binance · Real' card with 'Unable to load balances' pulled from /api/binance/account — duplicates the same error information the new yellow banner already shows. Not a bug, but the UI now displays two error boxes for the same underlying condition.
seed_data_creation: None. Admin binance_keys.mode was temporarily flipped to 'demo' during regression test and restored to 'real' at completion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend geo-block wallet handling is verified. Admin is in 'real' mode with a bound Binance key that the server cannot reach (US region). If retesting, use test_wallet_real_mode.py which auto-flips to demo and restores. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/screenshots/wallet_real_mode_verified.png show the yellow banner + Real · Not Connected label.
